name: IBY_FILE_ACKS
description: Stores bank acknowledgments for the payment files sent

columns.name: INBOUND_FILE_ID
columns.description: If funds capture flow, foreign key to inbound file record at IBY_INBOUND_FILE.INBOUND_FILE_ID.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLOW
columns.description: Specifies funds capture or disbursement flow.  Values taken from lookup: IBY_PAYMENT_FLOW

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: If disbursement flow, foreign key to payment file at IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL .

columns.name: MBATCHID
columns.description: Foreign key to settlement batch at IBY_BATCHES_ALL .MBATCHID.

columns.name: PROCESSING_STATUS
columns.description: Processing status for the acknowledgment record.

columns.name: ACKED_ORIG_FILE_ID
columns.description: File-level identifier of the acknowledgment record. Maps to OriginalMessageIdentification in ISO20022 schema.

columns.name: ACKED_ORIG_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Original network file name assigned by the system when sending out the payment file. Maps to NetworkFileName in ISO20022 schema.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_COUNT
columns.description: Number of transactions in the file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
